mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% for three consecutive months reduces near-term discount rates, lowering the present value of expected equity cash flows and thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: Rising inflationary bias in the Fed’s policy framework
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns show no statistically significant deviation from the pre-rate hike mean during the triggered period (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment claims (PAYEMS) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in new job openings (indirect proxy via INDPRO) signals a weakening labor market, which increases perceived risk and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by > 10% month-over-month while INDPRO decreases by > 5% month-over-month
regime_hint: Early-stage labor market softening in a growth cycle
failure_condition: During triggered events, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive and statistically significant (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.5% year-over-year growth for two consecutive months indicates strengthening construction activity and consumer confidence, which elevates equity risk appetite and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST monthly YoY growth > 1.5% for two consecutive months
regime_hint: Recovery phase in the US housing market
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative or flat during all triggered events (median p > 0.5).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month, followed by a decline in consumer goods orders (implied via RSAFS), suggests supply-side constraints that raise input costs and reduce corporate profit expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO MoM < -2% and RSAFS MoM < -3% in the same month
failure_condition: During triggered events, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive and statistically significant (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% and coincides with a sustained decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) year-over-year, it signals a strong labor market and disinflation, which supports risk-on sentiment and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY < -0.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns show no correlation with the trigger (Spearman's rho < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in monthly payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 200,000 jobs without a corresponding rise in job openings (INDPRO) indicates a mismatch between labor demand and supply, raising uncertainty and compressing equity valuations, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 200,000 and INDPRO flat or declining YoY
regime_hint: Labor market imbalances in a growth cycle
failure_condition: During triggered events, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive and statistically significant (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in retail sales (implied via indirect proxy: negative trend in HOUST) for three months suggests weakening consumer demand, which lowers growth expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST monthly decline for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are non-negative and statistically insignificant (p > 0.1) during all triggered events.

mechanism_narrative: During a sharp rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL month-over-month > 0.4%) without a corresponding increase in industrial production (INDPRO), it indicates supply-side inflation pressures that erode real earnings and compress profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL MoM > 0.4% and INDPRO flat or declining YoY
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive and statistically significant (p < 0.05) during all triggered events.
